balls.text: walks all across his stumps and goes for a slog sweep, but the good length ball is too quick for him and it sails through to the keeper
offcutter on off stump, he swings and misses but the nonstriker rushes across and pinches a single
low full toss on off stump, slapped away through the covers.
clears his front leg and carves the length ball over point. Couple to deep third man
hurries him on middle and leg, manages to push down the ground for a single
fullish and outside off, that's a Test match length and he beats Sharma's uncertain push
strays on the pads and this is turned away in front of square leg
pushed through on a good length, Sharma pokes outside off and is comfortably beaten

that's three in the over! Balaji goes for a sweep across the line and is caught in front of middle. This pitched on a good length and skidded onto him, strikes on the knee-roll and that's a pretty easy decision for Umpire Dharmasena
tossed up on off stump, lunges forward and blocks
through him first ball! Reaches forward but he has a big gap between bat and pad as he played down the wrong line. The ball turns in and off stump is knocked back

it happened like clockwork. Lured him out of his crease with a flighted delivery, but it pitches and turns across him. Patel had no clue as he wafts at it. No connection made and the keeper whips off the bails. All too easy
gets this to rise up around his chest, Patel is back and up on his toes as he nudges into midwicket region
145kph, shortish and outside off, he looks to steer it down to third man. Misses

he succeeds in doing what Maxi failed. Walks across and scoops Morkel over fine leg. It wasn't quite the yorker though, in fact it was the perfect length to help on its way. But you have to be brave to try that against a 150kph bowler
this was short but was tagged with a bit of width and Dhawan has backed away and forehands it over mid-on. Punjab need a few of those
backs away and slaps the length ball to mid-off
and straight away he's too quick for him. Backed away and looks to work through midwicket, but the back of a length ball goes through him to the keeper
set up for the slog sweep on the off stump, but Narine pulled his length back. Carts it along the ground to deep midwicket
little nibble away and Dhawan can only defend it back to the bowler
waits on his back foot and turns it away through square leg. Didn't look completely convincing
this turns away from him, Patel stays back and dabs to short third man
shortish and outside off, Dhawan pulls down to long-on
tosses it up outside off, Patel drives down to long-on
pushed through on leg stump, Dhawan pushes forward to block but gets struck on the pads. No appeal as it would have been going down
flighted on middle, he sweeps confidently to deep square leg
gorgeous loop on this and he is lured into a push through the covers. Goes uppishly but it is too far to the left of Yusuf
teases him outside off, Dhawan chases it and taps it to point. That would have been a wide
rocks back and cuts into the covers, but Yusuf throws himself to his right and keeps it to nothing. That was timing quite well
flighted on middle, turned away into the midwicket region and Chawla himself races after it
fullish and outside off, he pushes to mid-off and collects a well-run single
shortish and outside off, he hacks it down towards midwicket. Slower ball foils his timing
strays on the pads and he's clipped it away to the fine leg boundary. Nicely done
leans into a lovely drive to point. Dhawan looking like he belongs as he eases a good length ball, but fails to find the gap
short ball and Patel, who is named 'Axar' in the back of his shirt, isn't too comfortable. Pulls quite late and it goes to the left of mid-on
back of a length, he taps it past the outstretched right hand of point

googly goes through and Sehwag looks woefully at his middle stump that's taken a battering. Foxed him all ends up and with his penchant for lead feet, Sehwag and his feeble prod bad no choice. That's also the time out
shortish and turning away, Sehwag pulls to long-on
the frustration gets to him. Tossed up on middle and Bailey slams him down the ground. It's a big boundary there and Morkel is patrolling it. Takes a reverse cup supremely comfortably
Bailey advances now, but it's pushed through and he has to adjust and wears it on the pads
skips down the track and looks to swipe at it. Gets a thick inside edge that trickles down towards short fine leg
stays low but since he was already camped on the back foot he's able to chop it down to the sweeper
pushed through and it's clipped down to long-on
evades Pandey at cover. This was a leading edge as Narine tempts him with a flighted delivery. Sehwag clears his front leg but mistimes the stroke
a little too short that time and Bailey escapes with a push to long-on
stays rooted to the crease as he blocks the delivery. He's not reading him off the fingers
wanders down the track and tentatively nudges to the right of the bowler
nervous start from Bailey as he goes back to block a bit of a legbreak
gives the googly a bit of air, Bailey hasn't picked it as he looks to drive through the covers. Gets an inside edge through square leg
flighted onto the pads, Sehwag nurdles it behind square leg
another Sehwag special! Backs away after he sees the ball short and cuts it behind point. Opened the face just enough to bisect the two men in the area
flighted just outside off, Sehwag doesn't bother with his feet and pushes into the covers
stays back and punches down to long-on. it was full enough to come forward but I suspect Bailey likes using his back foot
tossed right up on off stump, Bailey was looking to wind up but decides against it
it's Sehwag's turn this time. This was full and on the pads, Sehwag flicks to the right of long leg. Wonderful timing
fullish and outside off, Bailey taps and runs into the off side
that's gorgeously placed. Bowling short is giving Bailey enough time to rock back and pull it well square of long leg
hurried into him and Bailey was caught midway through a short-armed jab. Manages to push it down to long-on
back of a length and outside off, Sehwag opens the face on impact and punches it through to the sweeper
shortish and outside off, Bailey pulls with authority to deep midwicket
tossed up outside off, turned away down to long-on
loopy legspinner outside off, Sehwag is forward and slaps it through to the sweeper

there's another tactical victory for Gauti. Miller races down to the googly and slogs it. Gets it right off the bottom of the bat and Morkel, the tallest bloke in the park, collects a safe, jogging catch at long-on
tossed up googly, misreads it as he goes for a slog sweep. Gets struck on the back pad, but the leg before shout was in vain as it was going past off stump
short again and Miller waits on the back foot to see which way it turns. Doesn't, so he punches it past a diving short cover
a little short to start off and Sehwag stays back and pulls to long-on. On the bright side there is a bit of turn out there for him
good length ball on and around off stump, Miller works it wide of long-on and they scamper across for a couple and that brings us to a time out
makes up for it with a top-class cover drive. Leans into the overpitched delivery outside off and scythes it through the infield
heaved past mid-on. It was length and he pushed his weight forward and gets it more off the inside edge than anything
carves it to third man with an open face as Kallis delivers a shortish one with a little room
fullish on off stump, Miller is forward and drills it down to long-off. Made such a good sound off the bat
full on off stump, pushes down the ground with a straight bat
back of a length on leg, Miller works it away towards square leg
meets him with a short ball at 146.9 kph and Miller is rammed on the glove. This is definitely Mornzilla

leg stump cartwheels and KKR erupt! He was moving well across outside off to try and pick it away fine. But this is a gorgeous yorker from Morkel and when he doesn't hit, it's timber. Gamble pays off. Maxi has been playing extravagant shots to great results, but this was just a little too much
fires a yorker that was seeking the base of middle, Sehwag does well to dig it out to mid-off
back of a length and on the stumps, Sehwag backs away and cuts. Little more bounce than he thought and he's beaten
that's a mis-hit. He was advancing and Morkel pushes it wide. Gets it off the toe and it goes straight up. But falls well short of the on-rushing deep third man
goes down and thumps a length ball from Kallis to long-on
length and outside off, he looks to pull it but doesn't account for the slower pace. Gets an inside edge that hits his toes and stops beside the wickets. Maxi calls him through for a single
back of a length, nudges it into the fine leg region and races down seeking a couple. Sehwag though has only jogged across to the other end
sneaks in a short ball and it had a little more oomph behind it. Nice height on it as Maxi looks to hook and misses. Pretty close to being called a wide too
full on middle, Sehwag clips it and those wrists have enough power to find deep midwikcet
fullish and outside off, Maxi looks to hack it through midwicket but gets an inside edge through to deep fine leg
prodded rather calmly down to long-on. Was in the air a little as he failed to reach the pitch
first ball against Narine and he's reverse swept him to the point boundary! It was in the slot and Maxi's power comes to the fore again
moves around in the crease to try and fox the bowler, who tosses it up on middle. Nudged through midwicket. Well bowled that
pushed through just outside off, Sehwag wants to hit it inside out through extra but it beats the outside edge
slog swept and this has Sehwag written all over it! On middle and he lunges forward and with that big backlift, he's murdered it over deep midwicket
goes after him straight away, sees a little bit of flight and lofts him with an open face. Not too well timed though
there we go. Skips down the track while making a bit of room, Kallis tried to put this out of his reach but just ends up giving all the room necessary for him to slap it through extra cover
slides this one down the leg side, Maxi can't glance it away
what happened there?! It was dug in short and he was looking to duck under it but the bat was propped straight up. Periscoped it beyond the reach of short fine leg
fullish and on the pads, Maxi pushes to mid-on
shortish and outside off but Sehwag has moved outside off and looks to pull off one foot, doesn't connect properly and has to settle for a single behind square leg
on a good length, Maxi shuffles across and picks it away into the square leg region

Kallis and his golden arm strikes! Saha was walking right across his stumps and is found in front of middle and leg. Starts with a full one that tails in just a touch, Saha was playing a little around his front pad and pays the price
back of a length and on middle, nudges it through to square leg

this is into the grass banks behind long leg! It was length and Saha swung for all his worth. Did not time it, in fact the bat turned on impact but he gets enough height on it for the trajectory to take it beyond the boundary
whoa! Seems it wasn't so much of a nothing shot this time. Attempts it again and though he gets it high on the bat, it is picked away to the long leg boundary

this is a swirler and Yadav racing in from deep third man has spilled it. Plays a nothing shot to a shortish delivery on middle, gets a thick leading edge that soars up in the air. He gets both hands to it but it pops out. Camera pans to a pensive Lynn
he's bowling a terrific length here. Digs into the pitch and gets the ball to jag back into the batsman. Saha is cramped for room and has to pull off the bottom hand while he adjusts to defend
tucks him up with a back of a length delivery on the pads, Sehwag looks to glance it fine but it brushes his thigh pad and goes to the keeper
stand and deliver! Takes us back to his glory days as he pummels a fuller delivery offering him ample room to free his hands. Bounces about an inch from the extra cover boundary
shuffles across his stumps to whip the back of a length delivery off middle to deep fine leg
back of a length with a bit of width, Sehwag stands up tall and punches to cover point
shortish delivery on his hips, Sehwag clips to square leg
straying on the pads but Viru cannot pick it away. Struck on the pads and it wanders away
that's a brute! This time the bouncer follows Saha as he sways inside the line. Does exceptionally well jerk away and not get hit. Morkel is enjoying this pitch
bouncer to start off and Saha drops his wrists and sways inside the line

stays dead still and pushes away from the body. The fullish delivery is inside edged onto pad and skews out towards point. They want the single but Pandey swoops in from point and hits direct. Pujara is caught short. So from celebrating the overthow going to the boundary, Punjab are one down
thuds into Sehwag a lot quicker than he expects. It was back of a length and darts in off the pitch, Sehwag is up on his toes looking to block but is struck high on the pads.
fullish on middle and leg, Sehwag doesn't move much as he nudges into midwicket
back of a length and outside off, Pujara swats it down the throat of mid-off but it's a free hit and he treats himself to a single

Morkel, you absolute beauty! Cuts Pujara in half with an inswinger that was pitched short of a length. The movement was prodigious and the umpire reckons it's been gloved before lobbing up into the hands of the keeper. Only one problem though, he's overstepped by several inches. So not only is there no wicket, it's a free hit. The glove was off the bat as well, so it shouldn't have beeen out in the first place
that's trademark Pujara. Short and outside off, he waits on the back foot and cracks it to point. Diving effort needed to stop that
back of a length on off stump, Pujara tucks it around the corner and gets a couple. These two aren't the quickest and Pujara had to stretch
straightened a touch on middle and off, Pujara blocks with a straight bat. Lovely full length again
width on offer and he's drilled it through the covers. That's what he said he wanted to concentrate on, using proper cricket shots to collect his runs. Batting outside his crease too
persists with a fuller length after seeing the ball dart around. Pujara presses forward and finds mid-off
flirts with an outswinger outside off, rather tame effort from Pujara and he's beaten first up

slower ball cleans up middle stump. It was full, Umesh was not interested in getting in line as he offers a terrible excuse of a shot. Rooted to the crease and soundly beaten as he played inside the line
rushes back to his mark, over-rate is 11.2. Back of a length and outside off, Morkel steers it down to third man
that's a yorker gone wrong. Ends up a low full toss that sneaks down leg
short ball angled in again, Morkel goes back and swivel pulls to fine leg
lifts the back of a length delivery over midwicket. Cramped for room but still manages to clear the infield
fuller on off stump, swung away wide of mid-on

that's the end of that then. Back of a length and outside off, he looks to force the pace with a loft over the off side. Hits him a little too high on the bat and cover makes no mistake. Fooled by the shorter ball
goes a little shorter this time and Surya gets a lucky glove to the third man boundary. Went down on one knee to lap him to fine leg, but he'll settle for what he gets
swept to the square leg boundary! That was a rocket! It was fullish and he had to drag it from outside off again, but this slow pitch doesn't seem to be affecting him
keeps strike as he nudges the good length ball straight of midwicket
short of a good length, but it's a little too far outside off. A little tough on the bowler, that was almost inside the wide line
skips down the track to a length ball and lofts it over mid-off. Struck it off the bottom of the bat and long-on runs around to keep it to two
he's tremendously good with that shot. Picks it on a length and drops it into the boundary at square leg. Dragged it from outside off, but this time his timing was perfect
this was on a good length on off stump, Umesh opens the face towards third man
beats him outside of as he bowls just back of a length. Umesh was not keen to get in line and threw his bat at it
slower ball foils Surya's hopes of timing this over the top. just short of a good length and he wanted to give himself some room. The slap over the covers ends up at long-on

off stump is uprooted and Johnson roars! Goes full and Narine was backing away and looking to loft it over the covers. The batsman misses, Johnson hits. Bet he remembered Narine making a fool of him in the first innnings. That's the time out now
tests the middle of the deck with a 141kph delivery. Narine doesn't want anything to do with it
back to his usual pace, but this time Yadav sways inside the line and ramps it to third man
away she goes over the square leg boundary. He picked the slower ball early, walked across and swiped it over the head of the fielder
short ball on leg stump, Narine shuffles across and works it down to long leg
backs away and slices the full delivery off middle stump to deep point
good length ball, goes back and looks to heave it down the ground. Absolutely no timing on the shot
shortish and outside off, Yadav dabs it to short third man who is slow to get down. Balaji's misfield ends up giving three
beats the dive of a deepish mid-off. It was shortish again but Yadav skips down the track and slaps it down the ground
opens the face and runs the shortish ball to third man
steps down the track and pushes the back of a length delivery to long-on
big change of pace there. Narine was complete with his flick over leg by the time the ball hits his back pad. Big appeal, but the fuller delivery had pitched outside leg
looks to force it down the ground, but cant get it past the bowler
another one that skids into him, Narine pushes down the ground
races down the track and he looks for a loft it over the covers. But this goes on with the arm and the keeper pulls off a smart stumping
flat on leg stump, punched to long-on. Patel's doing a pretty good job here
comes down the track and looks to whip through midwicket, skids onto him a little too quickly and has to settle for a leg bye to point
goes back and pushes to long-on
legcutter outside off. Uthappa dabs into the covers and sets off. But Bailey swoops in, picks up and throws in one motion and has hit the base of the stumps. Uthappa had almost given up
comes down the track, but the length of this has been pulled back. Yadav steals a leg bye
full and outside off, he moves outside off and clips to behind square leg
this stays low after darting in at the pads. Pathan was trying to flick across the line and has been judged leg before. Would have clipped leg stump
another legcutter just outside off, Uthappa steers it to deep third man
slower ball, Pathan is forward and tucks it through midwicket
flighted on off stump, he steps forward and drives to long-off
good lnegth ball on the stumps, defended
goes for the orthodox one this time, a little lap around the corner. Akshar appeals for leg before and he should feel aggrieved because that hit him in line and low enough to hit the stumps
uses the pace of the bowler there. it was on a length and he carefully come forward and reverse swept it fine of the short third man fielder
good length ball on off stump, turned away through midwicket
the stumps are in disarray! It was quick and flat and Lynn's expansive hit down the ground amounts to worse than nothing. Punjab's players are skipping about here
looks to steer it down to third man but the back of a length delivery outside off beats him
goes wide of the crease and provides length again, Lynn slogs it to deep midwicket
heaves it over short fine leg and it has enough to reach the boundary. Saw it on a length and outside off, moved across and swipes it over the infield
back of a length on middle, Uthappa is across on off stump and dabs a single into the middle of the pitch
length ball, comes forward and swings it away past mid-on
good length ball, Lynn comes forward and punches into the covers
pushed through on middle, Lynn heaves it along the ground to deep midwicket
backs away to launch it over mid-off, but he plays inside the line
full on middle, Lynn presents a dead bat
goes ofr a little bit of innovation here as he goes for a reverse sweep off a quicker delivery on leg stump. Only manages a single to fine leg
on a good length, but Uthappa is quick to make some room and lofts it over extra cover. Lovely stroke
flatter trajectory, but it still invites him forward to block down the pitch
pulls the bottom hand off the bat as he hits the short of a good length delivery down to mid-off. Might have been a little too early on the shot
a little too much effort into that. Sends a back of a length delivery a little too far outside off
fullish on off stump, pushed down the ground to rotate strike
back of a length, he goes forward and drills it through the covers. Hitting on the up but his connection is quite sweet
that's what you do when you get down the track. It was converted into a length delivery and his footwork also enabled him to free his arms. Slapped to the left of mid-off
steps down the track, but he gets it to seam in late. Strikes him on the pad and they sneak a single in front of point
good length ball on off stump, defended off the front foot
this one drifts down leg and Uthappa clips to deep midwicket and that will be the time out
think this was the arm ball, on a good length and skidding on. Uthappa who was backing away for a cut, just about connects
reaches forward and laps the flighted delivery over the keeper
straightens just a touch as Uthappa shuffles across and blocks
pushed through and it doesn't turn, Uthappa is on the back foot and pushes to mid-on
tossed up on off stump, defended

lashed over the covers. He comes down the track and though Dhawan tried to put it beyond his reach outside off, Uthappa manages to strike it off the bottom of the bat. There is a man in the deep though
gets a little bit of nip outside off, Uthappa lunges forward with half a bat and is beaten
fullish on off stump, he comes forward and blocks with bat and pad close
not quite short enough, but he does go for a pull off the front foot. Gets a bit of an inside edge to score his first runs today
good length ball outside off, Lynn blocks down the pitch
a little too wide outside off to connect with and the umpire agrees
full toss tailing in, Uthappa clips it to deep midwicket
stays back and guides this shortish ball with a bit of room down to third man
opens the blade to guides this fuller delivery outside off to point
fullish and in the channel, Uthappa is forward and defends
fullish on off stump, comes forward and pushes into the covers
full but angling down leg, Uthappa moves across and clips it to the fine leg boundary. Well played

and he strikes straight away! Punjab are making a fight of this! This was a good length ball outside off, Kallis goes forward and unleashes one of his square drives. But he fails to keep it to ground and Maxwell makes no mistake
back of a length and outside off, Lynn punches down the ground
back of a length on off stump, he presents a straight bat
just short of a good length but Lynn slaps it to short cover. That was crunched
shortish and outside off, taps it into the covers
back of a length and outside off, pushes back to the bowler

not a duck this time, but is that enough of a silver lining for the KKR captain though. Oh, but wait we're checking the bowler's front foot now. It was a length ball on middle, Gambhir cleared his front leg and looked to slash it through the covers. The bat face turns on impact and he holes out to short extra cover
third time's the charm and he helped himself by stepping down the track and hoisting it over extra cover. Powerful shot
he's off the mark in the IPL! Mitch has his hands in his head as he delivers a full delivery on the pads. Clips to long leg
137kph, predictably it;s the short ball to start off. Only it's outside off and he sways inside the line
shortish and outside off, he pulls down to long leg and a single, very awkward shot though. Gauti v Mitch now
this time it's full but the result is the same. Kallis chases it and is beaten outside off
throws his bat at a back of a length delivery angled across him, beats him well before he went into the shot
fullish and curling in slightly, Gauti blocks tentatively

dropped by the bowler! Gambhir survives! Played too early as he came forward to the good length ball straightening its line. Gets a leading edge that Sharma just about gets the fingertips to as he dives to hsi right

that's been given! This time it's the indipper and Pandey was pushing down the wrong line. A lovely length from the bowler, he knows his strength is swing and sticks to it. Half-push forward and is struck around the knee-roll.
back of a length on middle, Pandey stays back and blocks
tries to do it again, but this time he gets a bit more lift and Pandey's push connects only with air. Nicely away swing being generated
walks at the fullish delivery on off stump and outside edges it to deep third man
another drive, this time a length ball, doesn't beat short cover
pitched up once more, 150kph, driven crisply towards cover but can't get the placement right again
full ball on off stump, driven towards point this time, can't find the gap
doesn't seem to have affected him though, pulls out one of those exquisite cover drive, past a diving Geroge Bailey, all along the ground

Kallis didn't have much of any idea about that, he was looking to thump that through the covers, but edges it and isn't sure where the ball is, Kallis looks towards backward point but the ball is dribbling in front of him
starts with a 145.6kph swinging low full toss on off stump, Kallis gets his bat down in time
well outside offstump, Pandey reaches out for that and plays in uppishly towards cover point, there are fielders prowling there but this one is wide of them and he gets a boundary
chopped down towards third man, should have been a single but a slight mistake from Balaji allows the second
another dot ball, not much movement this time, Pandey looks to drive through the off, thick inside edge onto the pads
the ball curl in towards the stumps once more, Pandey was down the track hoping to counter the movement but can't get bat properly on it, ball rolls towards midwicket
cuts back in a long way, short of length ball pitching outside off and curling back a long way, Pandey going for the cut but surprised by the movement
swinging yorker on off stump, 126kph, dug out towards cover
Sandeep Sharma starts with a wild delivery down the leg side
